Ceasefires and war settlements

After establishing formal contact with three external polities, you can establish a multilateral settlement and dispute protocol. Regional supply chains can use goods on hand for circular offset settlement. Neutral third parties will mediate, while defensive allies will weigh their raw material dependencies and multiple treaties before deciding for themselves whether to enter the war directly.
